question:
Study the following line graph carefully and answer the given question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b9895f122728ce7cea41cddc03fb73a8cb09130314bb5603243b54c2b087a79.png] 

The number of bicycles sold in 2013 is approximately what percent of the number of bicycles sold in 2017?
solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ B₂₀₁₃ = 45 (Assumed from graph)

⇒ B₂₀₁₇ = 90 (Assumed from graph)

⇒ Percentage = (B₂₀₁₃ / B₂₀₁₇) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (45 / 90) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 50%
